_note: Ported from meta-journeys-npv.xlsx. ILLUSTRATIVE / MODELED — Meta's internal costs are not public and Journeys is hypothetical. NPV is independent of the MAU base (it drives only the adoption-% context).
arpu_note: Incremental NET ARPU per active Journey user. Yr0–1 = better ad targeting; Yr2+ = sponsored labeled recommendations; Yr4+ = commerce, affiliate & premium coaching layered in.

phases.name: Seeded Closed Beta
phases.driver: Small core eng/design building the MVP; Founding Journeys creator program (incentive is amplification, low cash cost).
phases.benefit: Proves the core loop; sets cultural norms before scale. No revenue yet.

phases.name: Public Launch (Instagram)
phases.driver: Scaling eng + infra to all IG users; the 'Everyone Starts at Day One' campaign; Explore/feed/discovery; creator waves.
phases.benefit: Validates loop at scale & cold-start. Organic only — sets up monetization.

phases.name: Monetization + WhatsApp
phases.driver: Sponsored-recommendation ad-tech build; cross-app WhatsApp integration; continued marketing.
phases.benefit: Revenue begins (sponsored, labeled recs). WhatsApp lifts retention — the multiplier.

phases.name: Video Journeys in Reels
phases.driver: Light eng — a badge + 'view full journey?' button on existing Reels; ongoing run-rate.
phases.benefit: Low-risk acquisition on-ramp from the highest-traffic surface.

phases.name: AI 'Try This Out?' CTA in Reels
phases.driver: AI integration into the crown-jewel Reels feed; heavy testing & guardrail monitoring.
phases.benefit: Turns Reels into a proactive acquisition engine — biggest funnel, highest risk.

phases.name: Facebook Expansion
phases.driver: Genuine re-design for Facebook (Groups, life-events) — not a reskin; FB-specific eng + marketing.
phases.benefit: Second native home, esp. for life-documentation journeys; higher-ARPU categories.

phases.name: Meta Glasses Coaching
phases.driver: Hardware integration & on-device AI coaching R&D; long horizon, highest uncertainty.
phases.benefit: Closes the flywheel; the ecosystem moat. Opt-in upside layer.
